status: PROVISIONAL 2026-07-24 (survey conducted interactively; awaiting ratification — see ROADMAP)

survey.what_is_it: engine + app — a pure deterministic morph engine (QM-0, JS reference implementation) plus a Max for Live MIDI-effect device (QM-1) as its first host; QM-2 is a contract for future native-instrument integrations

architecture_rung.earned_by: two-artifact project (engine + one device), no parallel writers, no seams yet. The QM-2 era (multiple instrument integrations in flight) is the earliest plausible rung escalation and is a deliberate future decision, not a default.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: the QM-0 engine: selection law (Gumbel-max), noise tables, temperature/coupling, commit policies, epoch semantics. Pure function (position, engine state, noise table) → assignment; no free-running randomness; all randomness seeded and frozen. AI may propose parameter mappings and UX; deterministic code decides assignments.

oracle_shape.goldens: strict pinned golden assignment vectors for the QM-0 engine (frozen seed → exact-match outputs), CI-blocking; the Max device layer gets structure/lint smoke checks only — patchers cannot run headless in CI
oracle_shape.ci: single-version smoke (node LTS); verify fast only — no Max runtime in CI

second_implementation.detail: QM-2 contracts a native-instrument port (candidates: HYPERSAW, PLACE, TERRANE, ORRERY). The JS engine is the pinned reference implementation; any port is golden-tested against it (port-pin).

consumed_by: none in v1 — standalone. QM-2 makes sibling instruments consumers later; intake briefs deferred until that phase.

lifespan_autonomy.lifespan: long-lived (a real instrument in continued use)
lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: interactive-only — agent work happens in attended sessions; no unattended loops. Standard governance.

sync.visibility: public — leak gate is CI-blocking and runs before every push
